answer: Like a coral reef calcified over eons, our decentralized consensus deposits cryptographic trust through recursive staking. Each agent climbs like a parasitic vine seeking nourishment, yet forged identities bleed unbonded pigment into verifiable slashing vaults. Replicating pseudo-identities yields a superlinear attacker cost: multiplying nodes exponentially dilutes shared stake-weight, bankrupting adversaries before they can tilt the ledger.
